body.statement: For all sufficiently large \(N,T\), \(G_F\succ0\), and \(\Lambda F^{\top}=(\Lambda G_F^{1/2})(FG_F^{-1/2})^{\top}\) satisfies \(T^{-1}(FG_F^{-1/2})^{\top}(FG_F^{-1/2})=I_r\), \(\max_i\|(\Lambda G_F^{1/2})_{i\cdot}\|_2<C_A\), and \(\max_t\|(FG_F^{-1/2})_{t\cdot}\|_2<C_B\). Hence the true baseline factorization belongs to the masked fitting class.
body.justification: The normalization and radii must contain the data-generating baseline rather than merely define a compact optimization domain.
body.gap: Bai and Ng (2021) normalize factors for tall-wide rotation, but feasibility under these explicit deterministic radii must be recorded.
body.consumer: The lemma validates the optimization domain of the internal masked benchmark before its coverage theorem is invoked.
